method: lifted boot = run of leg columns (leg-colour pixels connected to the boots) whose lowest row is 95-117 next to the planted foot (lowest row >= 119); lift = 123 - lowest row of that boot. Knee-lift frames = v3 k1,k2,k3,k5,k6,k7 (k0/k4 are foot-plant frames whose trailing leg is mostly hidden; not counted).

v4_casual.note: different motion (rear heel peel, the forward foot slides along the ground); peak lifts from walk_v4 measurements.json (lowest opaque row per screen half)

arms_phase.method: visible glove area (px, 672x448 video) per side in the v4 source frame: the arm swinging FORWARD (toward camera) shows a bigger, higher glove; the back arm is hidden behind the coat.

rows.legs_v3: k0: his R foot planting forward
k1: his L knee starting up
k4: his L foot planting forward
k5: his R knee starting up
